ModMetaData.name: RimMT
ModMetaData.author: Allen / Rimworld-Project
ModMetaData.description: Compatibility-first multithreading framework for RimWorld 1.5. V0.2 foundation provides a bounded worker scheduler, main-thread dispatch, Harmony conflict detection, circuit breakers, diagnostics, and safe fallback infrastructure. It does not parallelize Pawn.Tick or ReservationManager.
